answer.says: Sunil, another cup. I find I have not yet finished digesting the morning's absurdity.
answer.thought: The body is the first state of nature one must govern; I have neglected it in favor of the abstract. A cup of tea is a small act of self-preservation, a nod to the empirical side of my own existence before I return to the papers. The air is clear, but the heat lingers in the stone.
